Will you help my people fend off the vrykul assaults?$B$BFollow the road far to the northwest, across the river, and into the foothills of the mountains to reach Camp Winterhoof.

c55480299418790a64511181812b9324c5a1d1d5.QuestDescription: It is possible that the furbolg of Grizzly Hills have the same taint that plagued Vordrassil.  They've been involved in a deadly tribal war recently after years of peaceful coexistence.$B$BThe shrines that they guard to the east are home to Ursoc's offspring.$B$BIf the corruption has affected the furbolg, it is possible that because of their lineage, Kodian and Orsonn have remained unharmed.$B$BIf that's the case, find them and listen to what they have to say.

c555de0c57c97ee14bab66cb63f5f6276e15f329.LogDescription: The Atal'ai Exile in The Hinterlands wants the Head of Jammal'an.
c555de0c57c97ee14bab66cb63f5f6276e15f329.QuestDescription: My Witherbark companions don't take kindly to strangers around their home.$b$bMe? I don't have a home anymore. I was exiled from my people, the great Atal'ai tribe of the Swamp of Sorrows.$b$bOur spiritual leader, Jammal'an, had what he called a prophecy. He believes the summoning of the god, Hakkar will bring the Atal'ai immortality.$b$bBut I urged caution. What if the prophecy was nothing more than manipulation?$b$bI want revenge for my exile. Bring me Jammal'an's head. Maybe then my people will be free.

c59427675e0c506a876da6114fb11de8fcbe551a.QuestDescription: In balance with the other elements, water is the source and sustenance of all living things.  It gives and nurtures life, and all rely upon it for their existence.  Yet, when polluted, it also brings life to an end.$B$BWe must determine the extent of the damage that has been done.  To the southwest is one such contaminated body of water that has come to be known as the Foul Pool.  Travel there and extract the foul essence from the water spirits that inhabit the pool.

I do not recall seeing or hearing of a sword with these markings, but that doesn't mean that all is lost.$B$BKorialstrasz, better known as Krasus, has long been a friend to the quel'dorei and the Kirin Tor. With his vast knowledge and resources, he's certain to know something. Travel to the top of Wyrmrest Temple and seek his counsel, then report to Arcanist Tybalin inside the Silver Enclave in Dalaran.

c5cba33e6096b79f2f0f1c838213f2ff81637372.LogDescription: Ricket at K3 wants you to kill Gnarlhide.
c5cba33e6096b79f2f0f1c838213f2ff81637372.QuestDescription: I know just the job for an eager newcomer! We've got a gnoll problem. You might even call it a gnoll infestation! Pesky things. They keep creeping up more and more, and now they're on our doorstep, stealing our parts! Inconceivable.$B$BIt all begins and ends with their uppity leader, Gnarlhide. I want you to see to that "ends" part. Go pay him a visit at his camp all the way to the west, in Snowblind Hills.$B$BAnd when I say "pay him a visit," that's a euphemism for "kill him painfully." Kay? Kay!

c5ccd7f13339fd1591b509e58ad30ee333cc827d.Text: Choose your words wisely, death knight. You stand amidst the company of the devoted.

c5ce89feeb31e292f9e9fefbf3042faf1485e62c.CompletionText: I still hear their voices crying for help when the naga unleashed their chaos over us. If I didn't have this bad knee, I'd go and help you kill those blasted naga!$B$BYou can usually guarantee to find them deep in the coral reefs below the surface... lurking... scheming...

c5cf6ffc50e383d9f912e25d1655abfcb8a43a86.LogDescription: Bring 10 Gold Dust to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.  Gold Dust is gathered from Kobolds in Elwynn Forest.
c5cf6ffc50e383d9f912e25d1655abfcb8a43a86.QuestDescription: The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!$B$BYou can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.

c5d176dbf18ee82e4a166b322d11b37175a566ca.RewardText: It's a pleasure to finally meet you, $N. We owe you a great deal, but we're not done with you yet.$b$bThere is a vrykul city just over the mountains to the west, a place called Jotunheim.$b$bThe vrykul there are in a constant state of challenge to 'ascend'. The winners go to Ymirheim to serve as the Lich King's elite warrior caste, the Ymirjar, and the losers are reduced to Scourged Vargul.$b$bYou are going to be my instrument to see to it that more Vargul than Ymirjar emerge.

c5d7401899029246843edc3c3c586ccacc2e03b0.LogDescription: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.
c5d7401899029246843edc3c3c586ccacc2e03b0.QuestDescription: Long ago, the Highborne were some of the most powerful students of the arcane the night elves ever produced. The corruption that comes along with such studies caused much harm to night elf society and greatly affected all of Azeroth... as I'm sure you well know.$B$BI promised the Sentinels that I would release the spirits from their mortal bonds as I find them. If you would do the same, then I am sure I can reward you some.$B$BThe spirits haunt the Shadowsong Shrine to the northeast of here.

c5d7b247560b7f5cf5b86e8154af84c7a6e6d747.Text: It is an honor to serve along your side, $g sir:ma'am;.

c5d89f8f3f4c0850be1608810d3be78c80cf2ff1.LogDescription: Shadowstalker Canarius at Warsong Farms Outpost wants you to free 5 Scourge Prisoners.
c5d89f8f3f4c0850be1608810d3be78c80cf2ff1.QuestDescription: The soldiers that they didn't kill are being held in cages scattered across this farmland. Through some thievery we've managed to find a few keys, but we're unable to get close enough to any prisoners without being attacked.$B$BWe need your "talents" in securing those keys and freeing the prisoners. Bash in the brains of the necrolords and aberrations and take their keys. Use those keys to free Scourge prisoners.

c5d9da81da733e5811303d9234a2ae07928eb3bb.Text: Over here, to the southeast. I see they got you too...

c5db0eb44f80304616051d9e09649dc20c3870c7.Text: You will be judged for defiling these sacred grounds!  The laws of the Ancients will not be challenged!  Trespassers will be annihilated!

c5de97aa8e2d02f6357116126d6c98bd1edf5c05.comment: Hakkari Bloodkeeper - Out of Combat - Attack Start

c5e2c46e32c0e93d3961225e1a0a588239af4a2c.comment: Monstrous Ooze - In Combat - Cast 'Rancid Blood' (No Repeat)

c5e94628b15b088999e3e90cdb6117450ac2d30b.comment: Addled Leper - In Combat CMC - Cast 'Shoot'

c5ea094c4281b769f18ff20145cd92ddb4c3f9ca.Text: There is no doubt - you are the heir of Durotan... my grandson. Draka told me she was with child before she and your father left our world, but I never dared dream that they would survive...

c5ed6031cd981b8b0953d0d402dcf2bda47c50ed.Text: Mr. Perelli, I know you travel around quite a bit hawking your goods. Surely you've heard rumors or information about the Scourge?

c5f52fd535cabf73d5fa6adfffeb99991f4d3399.Text: I can only hope that he will see the Light and instead turn his energies to restoring once-beautiful Quel'Thalas.

c5fa3168b9a6583c4a7d2fb68d190adc1069f168.LogDescription: Give the Bundle of Skins to Harold Lane at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
c5fa3168b9a6583c4a7d2fb68d190adc1069f168.QuestDescription: I don't mind sharing.  I'm just glad to be saved from that creep, Gankly!  And I collected tons of skins from Zangarmarsh, so it's no problem at all!

c5fa43ffb6547b20492bc9e986f3099a9bb79d50.RewardText: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.

c5faf6d84b86a752e3fe230c2cb3d0f8365206fe.LogDescription: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
c5faf6d84b86a752e3fe230c2cb3d0f8365206fe.QuestDescription: $n, your skill as a leatherworker precedes you.  I possess leatherworking lore you would be wise to acquire... Wild Leather armor!  Wild Leather taps into the potent and chaotic properties of wildvines, found in areas of lush vegetation and on some of the creatures there.  Armor made using it is second to none for a crafter of your skill, guaranteed.$B$BI'll teach you, but you'll be working for me for a while.  The first cost is simply ten pieces of thick leather.  After this, we'll talk specifics.

c5fbc718290ec283cdcff645efde11359d66b751.CompletionText: No ordinary tributes were good enough for the great Hodir when he walked among the frost giants.$B$BHe might not be with us anymore, but we've kept the tradition of offering tribute to his strength and wisdom.  It would do much for your renown to partake in this tradition, small $c.

c5fdbb4d4dd33130ccc085a1b2c2f2baec548654.LogDescription: Commander Bargok wants you to kill 15 Alliance units or players in Blue Sky Logging Ground.
c5fdbb4d4dd33130ccc085a1b2c2f2baec548654.QuestDescription: We've suffered heavy casualties here, $r.$b$bThe only good news is that we've given as much as we've taken. I've requested more troops, but the bulk of our forces are bogged down in Venture Bay. It looks like we're on our own for now.$b$bNo matter how bad it gets, we MUST stand our ground! The precious resources of this region are essential to the Horde's long-term success in Northrend.$b$bWe've got to keep the Alliance on their heels until help arrives. Get out there and give 'em something to think about.

c5ff6a62d4150784676ea725c0239b4df2530000.LogDescription: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
c5ff6a62d4150784676ea725c0239b4df2530000.QuestDescription: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett!  I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.$B$BThe Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers.  Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.$B$BReclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me!  Help me restore my birthright!
